content_sections.heading: About DDMA Jalaun
content_sections.text: The District Disaster Management Authority is the disaster management body of Janpad Jalaun. This recruitment is being made for disaster management work in the authority, following the District Magistrate's order dated 04.11.2026. The notice is issued from the Office of the District Magistrate Jalaun at Orai and signed by Rajeev Raj, Additional District Magistrate (Finance/Revenue), Janpad Jalaun.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice prints the application form format. Applications are accepted only through Registered Post or Speed Post at this address: Office of the District Magistrate Jalaun (Disaster Section), Collectorate Orai, Janpad Jalaun. The notice does not print a PIN code. The last date for submitting the application is 13 November 2026. Applications received after the prescribed time on the last date will not be considered, so the application must reach the office by then. The form format and other information can also be obtained from the Disaster Section on office days between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM. The application form asks for the following: A recent passport size photograph must be pasted on the form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is 1 post of Disaster Expert (Disaster Professional), engaged on a contract basis at a fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month. Essential qualification: Graduate degree in any subject from a recognised university. Preference: Preference will be given to graduates who hold a Post Graduate qualification or Diploma in the field of disaster management. Experience: 03 years of work experience in the field of disaster management. Age limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years as on 01 July 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Application fee: Candidates do not have to pay any kind of application fee. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview on 20 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at the Collectorate, Meeting Hall (Sabhakaksh), Orai, Janpad Jalaun. Candidates bear their own travel expenses for coming to the interview. The decision of the Chairman of the Selection Committee will be final and binding, and the relevant Government Orders will be followed in the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DDMA Jalaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Disaster Expert (Disaster Professional) in the District Disaster Management Authority, Jalaun.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DDMA Jalaun Disaster Expert post?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026; applications received after the prescribed time on that date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Jalaun Disaster Expert post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in any subject from a recognised university is essential, along with 03 years of work experience in disaster management. Graduates with a Post Graduate qualification or Diploma in disaster management will get preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DDMA Jalaun Disaster Expert post?
faq.answer: The age must be minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years as on 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Jalaun Disaster Expert?
faq.answer: The post carries a fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for DDMA Jalaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, candidates do not have to pay any kind of application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the DDMA Jalaun Disaster Expert post?
faq.answer: Fill the application form in the format printed in the notice, paste a recent passport size photograph, and send it only by Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the District Magistrate Jalaun (Disaster Section), Collectorate Orai, Janpad Jalaun.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview for the Jalaun Disaster Expert post?
faq.answer: The interview is on 20 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at the Collectorate, Meeting Hall, Orai, Janpad Jalaun.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DDMA Jalaun Disaster Expert a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post will be filled on a contract basis for disaster management work.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No, candidates have to bear their own expenses for travelling to the interview.
